summary_1line: Curious about Durvasa’s mantra, the unmarried Kunti invokes the Sun god, who appears and insists she grant him a son.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kunti sits by a window at dawn, gazing at the rising sun as the radiant form of Surya emerges before her in golden armor and earrings.
Surya divides his blazing form in two in the sky—one blazing in the heavens while the other stands before the startled maiden in her chamber.
Kunti, blushing and frightened, looks upward to see the gathered gods watching from the sky while Surya stands shining before her.
